name: Power Strike
description: Double equipped attack minus armor. Each rank adds 4 damage.

name: Shield Bash
description: Strike and stun for this round. Each rank adds 3 damage. Cooldown: 3 other actions.

name: Rally
description: Restore 20 + Intelligence HP. Each rank restores 5 more. Cooldown: 4 other actions.

name: Shadow Strike
description: Attack + Agility against half armor. Each rank adds 4 damage.

name: Venom Cut
description: Half attack and Poison 5/round for 3 rounds. Each rank adds 2 poison damage.

name: Evasion
description: Shield absorbs 18 direct damage across 2 rounds. Each rank adds 4 capacity.

name: Ember Surge
description: Intelligence x2 + Level x2, ignores armor. Burn 4/round for 3 rounds. Each rank adds 3 direct damage.

name: Frost Bind
description: Intelligence damage, ignores armor and stuns this round. Each rank adds 3 damage.

name: Mana Ward
description: Shield absorbs 20 direct damage across 2 rounds. Each rank adds 4 capacity.
